newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSBC HK bond index rose 0.57 pct to 123.6 in April.
newsitem.headline: HSBC HK bond index rose 0.57 pct to 123.6 in April.

text.p: HSBC Markets said its Hong Kong bond index rose to 123.60 in April, a 0.57 percent increase from March.
The index was set at 100 on December 31, 1993.
The sub-index for Hong Kong government paper increased by 0.34 percent, while the sub-index for non-Hong Kong government paper rose by 0.75 percent, HSBC said in a recent report.

Compared with levels at end-April 1996, the overall index increased by 8.5 percent, the sub-index for Hong Kong government paper rose by 7.3 percent and the sub-index for non-Hong Kong government paper increased by 9.3 percent, it said.
